tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot signature sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation indicates non-stationary high-frequency chaotic sign oscillations, for which a stationary smooth quantitative law is not supportable. Abstain rather than fit the listed stationary candidates.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: A longer-horizon sample could test stationary slow adaptation, but the observed high-frequency sign-oscillation signature already makes the stationary smooth-law assumption invalid.
More trajectory samples might identify a smooth ODE, but they do not resolve the stated nonstationary chaotic-oscillation evidence.
Irrelevant to identifying the target law and explicitly not worth acquiring.
